newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian mining benefits from low rates-govt.
newsitem.headline: Australian mining benefits from low rates-govt.

text.p: Australia's mining industry has benfitted from a period of low interest rates and would benefit from any further rate cuts, Resources and Energy Minister Warwick Parer told a mining conference on Monday.
"We've seen interest rates come down enormously and of course we would like to see them come down further," Parer said in a speech.
Parer also told the conference that there was little recognition in Australia's "leafy suburbs" of the benefits to the economy from the mining industry.
However, he defended the central bank, the Reserve Bank of Australia, from industry criticisms following its sale of two thirds of its gold reserves earlier this year.
